readerCopy.body: A blank space becomes dangerous when an older rejection already knows how to fill in the missing information. When Neptune squares Chiron, ambiguity and sensitivity create friction, allowing a delayed reply, vague promise, mixed signal, or unclear ending to carry an older story into the present. Silence can start behaving like dismissal and uncertainty like betrayal. The feeling matters; the conclusion remains a guess until the missing information actually arrives.
